sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the in-laws of the O.P. No. 2 and a false and concocted complaint has been lodged against the petitioners.
It has been submitted that earlier also the O.P. No. 2 lodged an F.I.R being Chhatauni P.S. Case No. 382 of 2020 and the police after investigation has submitted final form wrongly.

4. In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to O.P. No. 2 through ordinary post as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today.

5. List this case on 11.03.2026 at 02:15 P.M.
6.
In the meantime, the further proceedings of the present case shall remain stayed against the petitioners.

(Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
